item.title: I Ask the NRA to Take a Stand on Florida’s Stand Your Ground Law
item.description: It’s time the NRA addressed Florida’s Stand Your Ground statute.

item.title: Amendment 4 Offers Second Chances and a Sensible Addition to the Constitution
item.description: Who would have thought a move to grant convicted felons a second chance to regain their voting rights back would be the most sensible amendment question on Florida’s November ballot?

item.title: Florida’s Latest Iteration of Voter Suppression — Parking on College Campuses
item.description: After a swell of voter participation of young, poor, and minority voters in 2008, more than 25 states have put into place restrictive voting laws. These voter suppression efforts, ranging from voter ID to early voting restrictions, disenfranchise marginalized communities with an interest in shaping the electorate. Florida’s latest iteration of voter suppression — parking.

item.title: Colorblind COVID-19 Should Open Our Eyes to Racial Disparities
item.description: The novel coronavirus has given Black Americans something we don’t need — another stereotype. Suspicions of black people because of false and ignorant beliefs are bad enough, but now we face a pandemic that has disproportionately impacted us.

item.title: Biden needs African American Woman On The Ticket
item.description: Joe Biden will soon make one of the most important decisions of his candidacy, and the former vice president and presumptive Democratic presidential nominee promised to pick a woman as his running mate.
